statement: Anything a side has signed and sent stays enforceable against it until a frame at a higher slot commits: a refusal or a yield does not void the proof, so it does not release the payer or an upstream hold for a lock the proof carries. The replica keeps the signed, unsuperseded frames (bounded by MAX_UNSUPERSEDED, past which it proposes nothing more) and `liveLocks` says which locks are still live; a lock is released when a higher-slot frame without it commits or after its deadline plus the reserve. R-REFUSED-RELEASES-PAYER is narrowed to that. Holding and releasing is the Runtime's duty.
